name: io.github.frod27/overwing
title: Overwing
description: Guardrails for LLM output. Score any text for safety, quality and compliance and get pass / fail / review verdicts with calibrated confidence in under 500 ms.

environmentVariables.name: OVERWING_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Overwing API key (ow_live_...). Get one at https://overwing.ai/login or POST https://overwing.ai/api/v1/signup

environmentVariables.name: OVERWING_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL for self-hosted deployments (default https://overwing.ai)
